name: Datamuse API
rate_limits: 100,000 requests per day. No API key required. May be rate-limited beyond that without notice.
notes: Word-finding query engine. No auth needed. Two endpoints: /words (find words matching constraints) and /sug (autocomplete). Supports queries by meaning (ml=), sound (sl=), spelling (sp=), rhyme (rel_rhy=), triggers (rel_trg=), and many more relation types. Context-aware via lc= and rc= parameters. Returns max 1000 results per query (default 100). Extremely useful for AI: semantic word relationships, building thesauri, word association networks, contextual word suggestions. Experimental service with no SLA but has been reliably running for years.
